title: Asian Games: Alas Women to battle Qatar in classification round
summary: The Alas Pilipinas Women try to salvage some measure of pride when they battle Qatar in the classification round of the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 on Sunday, Sept. 20.
